description:
## [1.2.0](https://github.com/catsmoker/anime-witcher-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) (2026-09-05)

### ✨ New Features

* add AMOLED black theme patch; consolidate TV and rebranding patches ([8fe3ff2](https://github.com/catsmoker/anime-witcher-patches/commit/8fe3ff2))

patches.name: AMOLED black theme
patches.description: Sets the dark theme backgrounds (window, toolbars, cards, dialogs) to pure black (#000000) so OLED and AMOLED screens turn those pixels off and battery is saved. Light appearance is unchanged. Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches.name: Android TV
patches.description: Adds full Android TV / Fire TV support: manifest declarations, TV launcher entry and D-pad remote navigation (focusable content rows, focus out of the top bar, dialog focus). Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches.name: Android TV: D-pad navigation
patches.description: Part of Android TV: makes the app fully navigable with a TV / Fire TV remote (focusable content rows, D-pad focus out of the top bar, dialog focus). Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches.name: Disable VPN detection and alerts
patches.description: Removes VPN/DNS detection and the VPN alert dialogs. Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables all ad display logic in the app. Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches.name: Play with external player
patches.description: Opens episodes in a system intent chooser so the user can pick their favorite video player (VLC, MX Player, etc.). Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches.name: Rebranding
patches.description: Renames the app to 'Anime Witcher +', changes the package id to app.catsmoker.anime.witcher, badges the icon with a red +, points Telegram links to https://t.me/CATSM0KER and credits the About screen. Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches.name: Rebranding: Telegram & About
patches.description: Part of Rebranding: points Telegram links to the configured handle (default https://t.me/CATSM0KER) and adds a credit line to the About screen. Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

options.description: Telegram username used for every support/contact link in the app.
Extra credit line appended to the About screen.

patches.name: Remove AppLovin initialization
patches.description: Removes AppLovin SDK initialization from the Application class. Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

patches.name: Remove startup popup
patches.description: Removes the update/changelog and appearance popups that appear when the app starts. Original APK: https://www.animewitcher.com/

release_notes:
## What's new

- **AMOLED black theme.** New optional **AMOLED black theme** patch turns the whole dark appearance true black (`#000000`) — window, toolbars, tabs, nav drawer, cards, dialogs and backgrounds — so OLED/AMOLED screens switch those pixels off and battery life improves. The light appearance is untouched.
- **Rebranding is now on by default.** The recommended **Rebranding** patch renames the install/launcher package to `app.catsmoker.anime.witcher`, moves every `com.anime.witcher.*` permission under it and badges the icon with a red + — so the mod installs and runs even when the original app is still installed (fixes `INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION` / `INSTALL_FAILED_CONFLICTING_PROVIDER`).
- **Configurable Telegram handle & About credit.** The `Rebranding: Telegram & About` sub-patch now exposes `telegram handle` and `about credit` options, so the support links and the About-screen credit line are fully customizable.
- **Faster, more reliable D-pad fix.** The Android TV support patch wires `TvFocusHelper` as an Activity lifecycle callbacks object, applies the focusability pass to every activity and every dialog the app shows, and only consumes a top-bar D-pad press once focus actually moved into a content row — so in-content D-pad navigation is left untouched.
- Website metadata on the patch source points to the original app page.

|---|---|
| AMOLED black theme | off |
| Android TV | off |
| Android TV: D-pad navigation | off |
| Disable VPN detection and alerts | on |
| Disable ads | on |
| Play with external player | on |
| Rebranding | on |
| Rebranding: Telegram & About | off |
| Remove AppLovin initialization | on |
| Remove startup popup | on |

Full details: https://github.com/catsmoker/anime-witcher-patches
